draft.title: Time series data
card: Time series data is a set of values recorded at regular times, such as each month or each year. Time goes on the horizontal axis, and the points are joined by lines.
Trend
the long-term direction of the data, such as a general rise or fall over several years. Small ups and downs along the way do not change the trend.
Seasonal pattern
a rise and fall that repeats at about the same time each cycle, such as higher sales every December.
Unusual point
a value far from the pattern around it, such as one month with a sharp spike or drop. It may have a special cause, so it is worth checking.

4.alt: A line graph of monthly ice cream sales over two years. Sales peak in January and dip in July each year, so the pattern repeats. Year 2 peaks are a little higher than year 1. One point in month 17 is a sharp drop.

draft.remember: Read a time series for the overall direction, the repeating cycle and any point that breaks the pattern.

a.q: A beach café's weekly takings are high every summer and low every winter, year after year. What is this pattern called?
a.why: The rise and fall repeats at about the same time each year, so it is a seasonal pattern. A trend is a long-term direction, and this data keeps returning to where it started.
a.clue: Does the rise and fall repeat each cycle?

b.q: Dev records the number of visitors to a museum each year from 2015 to 2024. Visitors rise by about 500 each year, except 2020, which is much lower. What is the best description?
opts: Upward trend, with 2020 an unusual point
b.why: Most years rise steadily, so the trend is upward. The 2020 value is far from the pattern around it, so it is an unusual point. One odd year does not cancel the trend.
b.clue: Does one odd year change the long-term direction?

b.best: Upward trend, with 2020 an unusual point
